title: Morning Rundown: three languages
summary: A test of per-segment languages: English, German and Chinese in one episode.

segments.title: Weather
segments.text: Good morning. It's foggy in Stuttgart this morning, four degrees, clearing up by the afternoon.

segments.title: German practice
segments.text: Heute lernen wir drei Wörter. Der Nebel. Der Frost. Die Sonne. Am Nachmittag kommt die Sonne heraus.

segments.title: In Chinese
segments.text: 今天早上斯图加特有雾，气温四度。下午天气会转晴。
